column1: # Member moves 1.21.1 -> 26.2, applied by tools/fix-missing-members.py ONLY where javac reports the owner type.
# <owner simple name> <old member> <new form>. Each row checked against the 26.2 jar (same parameters) and
# against how the shipped 26.2 ports call it.
# 26.2 made EnchantmentInstance a record: javac reports "<field> has private access", and the accessor has the
# field's name (both checked in the 26.2 jar: Holder<Enchantment> enchantment(), int level()).
# A UUID goes through a codec on 26.2 (§V12). CompoundTag and ValueInput/ValueOutput share the same
# store(String, Codec, T) / read(String, Codec) -> Optional pair, and UUIDUtil.CODEC writes the int array
# 1.21.1's putUUID wrote, so saved data reads back unchanged. 1.21.1's getUUID threw on an absent key.
# ValueInput (what convert-valueio hands a load body): getShortOr returns int on 26.2; contains is keySet().
# Entity.getCommandSenderWorld() was removed; it always returned level() (§V71).
# Harvested from the shipped multi-version ports (2-3 ports each); 1.21.1 owner and 26.2 member checked by javap.
